remarks: Wonderful Condominium in Silvermine - Prime Commuter Location This charming ranch-style condo features 1 bedroom and 1.5 bathrooms, with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The living room offers a cozy fireplace and flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating an inviting and open living space. The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, perfect for cooking and entertaining. The spacious and bright bedroom includes a newly renovated en-suite full bathroom. Sliding glass doors lead to a large private patio with a grassy area just across, offering direct access to the beautifully landscaped common grounds. Additional highlights include a large dry crawl space basement (19' x 38') for extra storage, and convenient parking located directly in front of the unit, along with ample visitor parking. Located in a desirable Silvermine neighborhood, just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North train station, and I-95, this home is perfect for commuters. Enjoy easy access to local shops, grocery stores, historic SoNo,Calf Pasture Beach, and more.
